INTENT:
This patch fixes the root cause of the NVDA/qhm 'sync_ledger REFUSED' / frozen-sells incident (2026-08-12). The QHM earnings-trim (a LEGITIMATE system-initiated reduction of a quarterly hold) does not notify the ownership ledger. The standalone run_ledger_sync.py RTH cron then sees: protected floor (2) > live net (1) and — correctly — REFUSES to shrink without operator confirmation. Result: CRITICAL every ~20 min during RTH, and once the guard is wired to gate sells, NVDA sells freeze until an operator manually runs confirm_ledger_heal.py. That manual step is required after EVERY QHM earnings-trim. This patch auto-confirms the system-initiated shrink so the next run_ledger_sync heals the floor automatically — with the same safety invariants as the manual path.

SAFETY INVARIANTS THAT MUST HOLD:
1. FILL-CONFIRMED ONLY: Auto-confirm written only after fill is verified (T1: existing 15s poll confirms broker net <= target; T2: new settle poll confirms broker net == 0).
2. NEVER-LAUNDER-A-BREACH: T1 strict equality guard (abs(confirmed_qty - intended_target) > 0.5) → skip confirm if concurrent breach detected. T2 only confirms if net == 0 (full exit confirmed by broker).
3. GUARD INTACT: This does NOT bypass ownership_guard.sync_ledger. The helper writes the SAME confirmation format as confirm_ledger_heal.py. The guard's match logic is unchanged.
4. FAIL-SAFE: Any error in the helper → return False → no confirm written → guard REFUSES → operator must run confirm_ledger_heal.py manually. The trim always succeeds regardless of hook outcome.
5. SCOPE: Only earnings-trim T1 and T2. No other QHM transitions auto-confirm.

+def _record_system_heal_confirmation(
+    sym: str, tier: str, target_qty: float, source: str
+) -> bool:
+    """System-initiated heal confirmation — same JSON format as confirm_ledger_heal.py.
+
+    Writes to ledger_heal_confirmations.json so the next sync_ledger call can
+    automatically accept a protected-tier shrink that was executed by the system
+    (e.g. earnings-trim). Reads live broker net via execution.broker.get_position
+    and verifies net >= target_qty - eps before writing — fail-safe: if the fill
+    has not settled, returns False and lets the guard REFUSE + page rather than
+    laundering a breach. Atomic tmp->replace with PID-unique tmp path (RC-5),
+    matching the established multi-writer pattern of _consume_heal_confirmations.
+
+    AUTHORIZED CALLERS: execution.quarterly_hold_manager._execute_earnings_trim_tier1
+    and _execute_earnings_trim_tier2 ONLY. Any other caller requires a full board
+    vote + Gro/GAI audit before adding.
+
+    Returns True if the confirmation was written, False otherwise (fail-safe,
+    guard keeps REFUSING, operator must run confirm_ledger_heal.py manually).
+    """
+    import time as _time
+    try:
+        try:
+            from execution.broker import get_position as _get_position
+            _pos = _get_position(sym)
+            live_net = float(getattr(_pos, "qty", 0) or 0) if _pos else 0.0
+        except Exception as _e:
+            logger.warning(
+                "_record_system_heal_confirmation: %s/%s broker read failed (%s) — "
+                "no confirm written (fail-safe: guard keeps REFUSING)", sym, tier, _e)
+            return False
+
+        eps = 1e-6
+        if live_net < target_qty - eps:
+            logger.warning(
+                "_record_system_heal_confirmation: %s/%s live_net=%.6f < target=%.6f — "
+                "fill not reflected; no confirm written (fail-safe).",
+                sym, tier, live_net, target_qty)
+            return False
+
+        confirm = {
+            "target_qty": target_qty,
+            "net_at_confirm": live_net,
+            "confirmed_ts": _time.time(),
+            "confirmed_by": source,
+        }
+
+        key = f"{sym}/{tier}"
+        existing = _load_heal_confirmations()
+        existing[key] = confirm
+
+        import os as _os
+        import json as _json
+        tmp_path = _HEAL_CONFIRM_PATH.with_suffix(f".{_os.getpid()}.tmp")
+        _HEAL_CONFIRM_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        with open(tmp_path, "w") as _f:
+            _json.dump(existing, _f, indent=2)
+            _f.flush()
+            _os.fsync(_f.fileno())
+        tmp_path.replace(_HEAL_CONFIRM_PATH)
+
+        logger.info(
+            "_record_system_heal_confirmation: %s/%s written — target=%.0f, "
+            "net_at_confirm=%.0f, confirmed_by=%s",
+            sym, tier, target_qty, live_net, source)
+        return True
+
+    except Exception as e:
+        logger.warning(
+            "_record_system_heal_confirmation: %s/%s unexpected error (%s) — "
+            "no confirm written (fail-safe)", sym, tier, e)
+        return False
